# Mountain Community Health

> > Mountain Community Health (MCH) is a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) in Bristol, Vermont, providing comprehensive medical, dental, and behavioral health services to all community members regardless of ability to pay.

MCH serves the Addison County area with patient-centered care, accepting insurance including Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and offering sliding fee scales. The organization actively engages with the Vermont healthcare community through events, partnerships, and its patient portal MyChart (My Health Vermont).

## Key Topics

- Mountain Community Health (MCH)
